fusions.name: End of the Tether
fusions.desc: Lunges at a target up to 5 tiles away for 12 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach, leaving it [Stunned] for 1 second and then moving 30% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Rattling Links
fusions.desc: Bites every enemy within 2 tiles for 7 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60%. Usable only on a target carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Junkyard Welcome
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 4 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Pulled Taut
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 5% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
